description: This file is a shell script used for testing and demonstrating merge attribute handling in Git, including custom merge strategies, conflict markers, and various merge scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up initial repository state with files and branches for testing merge attributes and custom merge drivers.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Performs merging of branches with different attributes and custom merge drivers, testing conflict scenarios, merge behaviors, and exception handling.

methods.name: check merge result in index
methods.description: Verifies the merge results stored in the index.

methods.name: check merge result in working tree
methods.description: Verifies the merge results in the working directory.

methods.name: retry the merge with longer context
methods.description: Tests the conflict marker size configuration and output.

methods.name: invalid conflict-marker-size 3a
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid conflict marker size configuration.

methods.name: custom merge backend
methods.description: Tests custom merge drivers and their behaviors during merges, including a custom script that simulates conflicts.

methods.name: custom merge driver that is killed with a signal
methods.description: Tests the behavior of custom merge drivers that are interrupted or killed during execution.

methods.name: custom merge does not lock index
methods.description: Ensures custom merge drivers do not cause locking issues in the repository index.

methods.name: binary files with union attribute
methods.description: Tests merging binary files with the 'union' attribute.

methods.name: custom merge driver that is killed with a signal on recursive merge
methods.description: Tests signal handling of custom merge drivers during recursive merge operations.
